visualCharacteristics.purpose: Product lineup switcher: large product image with prev/next arrows, tab labels below, then the active product name, description and buttons
visualCharacteristics.layout: Image on top, tab list below, text and buttons side by side on desktop
visualCharacteristics.interactions: Tab click, arrow keys/Home/End on the tab list, prev/next arrows cycle tabs

contentPattern.structure: one row per tab: cell 1 = tab label; cell 2 = product image, heading (model name), description paragraph, CTA links

usage: Truck model lineup on the homepage (6 models).
reuseGuidance: Use for any set of products switched by labelled tabs with one image each. Optional page metadata carousel-previous-label / carousel-next-label localize the arrows. The section-metadata based tabs block is separate.
